# Wild-scan target list — public OSS repos with webhook handlers we sweep
# weekly to prove hookwarden against real-world code.
#
# Selection criteria:
#   - ≥5k GitHub stars (credible / production user base)
#   - Recently active (push within last 6 months)
#   - Public Apache/MIT/AGPL license
#   - TS/Python/PHP source code (the languages hookwarden scans)
#   - Contains webhook handlers (Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, etc.)
#
# Adding a project: open a PR adding the org/repo line. Removing: same.
# We never publish per-target findings without coordinated disclosure.
# See bugs-in-the-wild.md for the methodology + privacy promise.
